versions.content: In accordance with [SWS_SomeIpXf_00245], 2  (8*sizeof(data type of length field)) shall be larger than the number of elements given by the size indicator multiplied by the size in bytes of each element (i.e., 1 for UTF-8 and 2 for UTF-16) and increased by the size in bytes required by the BOM.
